# guitarchords.info

> guitarchords.info is a free, open guitar reference tool. No accounts, no tracking, no paywall. It provides chord diagrams, a scale trainer, a chromatic tuner, and a metronome, all in the browser.

- Publisher: Suede AI (https://suedeai.ai)
- Creator: Jason Colapietro (also known as Johnny Suede)
- Canonical URL: https://guitarchords.info/
- Full reference text: https://guitarchords.info/llms-full.txt (each chord and scale page and the practice guides in one Markdown file)

## What guitarchords.info provides

- **Guitar chord chart**: 39 chord shapes with fingering diagrams in standard tuning: open major and minor, dominant 7th, maj7, m7, sus, power and common barre chords
- **Scale trainer**: 12 scales and modes in all 12 keys with fretboard visualization
- **Online tuner**: Chromatic tuner that works in the browser with no installation (https://guitarchords.info/tuner)
- **Metronome**: Tap-tempo metronome, 30–280 BPM (https://guitarchords.info/metronome)
- **Chord pages**: One page per chord in the library with its fingering chart, chord tones, intervals and related chords, for example https://guitarchords.info/chords/c-major
- **Scale pages**: One page per scale in the trainer with its formula, notes in all 12 keys, fretboard positions and related scales, for example https://guitarchords.info/scales/major

All tools run in the browser. No sign-up required.

## Notes

Articles by Jason Colapietro, founder and CEO of Suede AI in West Palm Beach, Florida (published 2026-11-14):

- [Notes index](https://guitarchords.info/notes)
- [Why a chord reference is built like a technical SEO project](https://guitarchords.info/notes/chord-reference-technical-seo): one data source per chord, schema built from the visible page, and llms-full.txt for AI crawlers.
- [Learning guitar in Palm Beach County: a four-week practice plan](https://guitarchords.info/notes/palm-beach-county-guitar-practice-plan): tuning, open chords, rhythm and the minor pentatonic in 20 minutes a day.
- [How Jason Colapietro ships fast, accessible static sites](https://guitarchords.info/notes/fast-accessible-static-sites): static pages, measured WCAG contrast and build-breaking tests, with a checklist for local web clients.
